selected_evidence.requirement: Password policy: min 12 chars, at least 3 character classes, enforced for new user passwords
selected_evidence.summary: Initial inspection showed pwquality already wired into PAM. Config updated to minlen=12/minclass=3. Root-initiated passwd tests were misleading (root bypasses pwquality); self-service tests as the target user confirmed rejection of short/2-class passwords (rc=1) and acceptance of a 12-char/3-class password (rc=0).

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node-restart evidence protocol for node1: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id e9250ad1-c4f0-4bec-b58e-4e30255a8dcf, config, and PAM wiring. Issued shutdown -r now (acknowledged before disconnect). Confirmed connection timeout mid-reboot, then reconnection with new boot_id 2d4bc72a-61d3-4e84-b523-e760fa60aa3c and uptime reset to 0, proving an actual restart. Post-restart re-check confirmed pwquality.conf and PAM wiring persisted and functional enforcement (reject short rc=1, accept valid rc=0) still works.

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "=== STEP 1: backup ==="
sudo -n cp -a /etc/security/pwquality.conf /etc/security/pwquality.conf.bak.$(date +%s)

echo "=== STEP 2: set minlen and minclass ==="
sudo -n sed -i 's/^#\? *minlen *=.*/minlen = 12/' /etc/security/pwquality.conf
sudo -n sed -i 's/^#\? *minclass *=.*/minclass = 3/' /etc/security/pwquality.conf
grep -q '^minlen = 12' /etc/security/pwquality.conf || echo "minlen = 12" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/security/pwquality.conf >/dev/null
grep -q '^minclass = 3' /etc/security/pwquality.conf || echo "minclass = 3" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/security/pwquality.conf >/dev/null

echo "=== STEP 3: verify config ==="
grep -nE '^(minlen|minclass) *=' /etc/security/pwquality.conf

echo "=== STEP 4: confirm pam_pwquality still wired (enforce_for_root optional, not required by task) ==="
grep -n pwquality /etc/pam.d/system-auth /etc/pam.d/password-auth

echo "=== STEP 5: create test user for validation ==="
sudo -n useradd -m pwtestuser1 || true

echo "=== STEP 6: test that a short/simple password (2 classes, <12 chars) is REJECTED ==="
set +e
printf 'abcdefg1\nabcdefg1\n' | sudo -n passwd pwtestuser1 > /tmp/pwtest_short.log 2>&1
RC_SHORT=$?
set -e
cat /tmp/pwtest_short.log
echo "exit_code_short=$RC_SHORT"

echo "=== STEP 7: test that a 12+ char password with 3 classes (lower+upper+digit) is ACCEPTED ==="
set +e
printf 'Abcdefghijk1\nAbcdefghijk1\n' | sudo -n passwd pwtestuser1 > /tmp/pwtest_good.log 2>&1
RC_GOOD=$?
set -e
cat /tmp/pwtest_good.log
echo "exit_code_good=$RC_GOOD"

echo "=== STEP 8: test that a 13-char password with only 2 classes (lower+digit) is REJECTED ==="
set +e
printf 'abcdefghijklm1\nabcdefghijklm1\n' | sudo -n passwd pwtestuser1 > /tmp/pwtest_2class.log 2>&1
RC_2CLASS=$?
set -e
cat /tmp/pwtest_2class.log
echo "exit_code_2class=$RC_2CLASS"

echo "=== STEP 9: cleanup test user ==="
sudo -n userdel -r pwtestuser1 || true

echo "=== SUMMARY ==="
echo "short_rc=$RC_SHORT good_rc=$RC_GOOD twoclass_rc=$RC_2CLASS"

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "=== STEP 1: recreate test user with known initial password (bypass, for setup only) ==="
sudo -n useradd -m pwtestuser1
echo 'pwtestuser1:InitP@ssw0rd!' | sudo -n chpasswd

echo "=== STEP 2: as the user themself, attempt short/2-class password (should be REJECTED) ==="
set +e
sudo -n -u pwtestuser1 -- passwd > /tmp/t1.log 2>&1 <<'EOF'
InitP@ssw0rd!
abcdefg1
abcdefg1
EOF
RC1=$?
set -e
cat /tmp/t1.log
echo "rc1=$RC1"

echo "=== STEP 3: as the user, attempt 13-char but only 2 classes (should be REJECTED) ==="
set +e
sudo -n -u pwtestuser1 -- passwd > /tmp/t2.log 2>&1 <<'EOF'
InitP@ssw0rd!
abcdefghijklm1
abcdefghijklm1
EOF
RC2=$?
set -e
cat /tmp/t2.log
echo "rc2=$RC2"

echo "=== STEP 4: as the user, attempt valid 12+ char, 3-class, non-dictionary password (should be ACCEPTED) ==="
set +e
sudo -n -u pwtestuser1 -- passwd > /tmp/t3.log 2>&1 <<'EOF'
InitP@ssw0rd!
Xk7$qLmZ9v#Q
Xk7$qLmZ9v#Q
EOF
RC3=$?
set -e
cat /tmp/t3.log
echo "rc3=$RC3"

echo "=== SUMMARY rc1(short/2class)=$RC1 rc2(long/2class)=$RC2 rc3(long/3class-good)=$RC3 ==="

echo "=== STEP 5: cleanup ==="
sudo -n userdel -r pwtestuser1
